meaning.en: The definition of a biologist is a person who studies the origin, history, characteristics and habits of living organisms.
meaning.vi: Định nghĩa của nhà sinh vật học là người nghiên cứu về nguồn gốc, lịch sử, đặc điểm và thói quen của các cơ thể sống.

meaning.en: A student of biology; one versed in the science of biology.
meaning.vi: Một sinh viên của sinh học; một người thông thạo về khoa học sinh học.

sentences.en: Code breakers and linguists were consulted, chemists and biologists patched up their differences and worked together, and scientific groups were formed to share information and theories.

sentences.en: But investigations carried out in connexion with the "Challenger" expedition indicated that it was an artificial product, composed of a flocculent precipitate of gypsum thrown down from seawater by alcohol, and the hypothesis of its organic character was abandoned by most biologists, Huxley included.
